description: Shapes for kind "shape" (and model parts). Solids fit a 1 m box; flat shapes are puffy cut-outs facing the camera, for 2D shape names. Every shape stands on y = 0. Add face: true for eyes and a smile.

block.description: A toy block: a cube with rounded edges, size 1.

cone.description: A party hat cone, diameter 1, height 1.

circle.description: A flat puffy circle (round, no corners), width 1.

square.description: A flat puffy square: four equal sides, four corners.

triangle.description: A flat puffy triangle: three sides, three corners.

rectangle.description: A flat puffy rectangle: two long sides, two short sides, width 1.4.

oval.description: A flat puffy oval (a stretched circle, like an egg lying down), width 1.24.

capsule.description: A pill shape (model parts: tails, ears).

box.description: A box with slightly rounded edges (model parts). Thinner than about 0.05 its corners turn to slivers: use plate for thin slabs.

plate.description: A thin rounded slab, 1 x 0.04 x 1, built at its true thickness so it stays solid: boards, mats, signs, trays and plates. Scale x and z for its size (scale y to make it thicker or thinner); stand it up with rotation [90, 0, 0].

pentagon.description: A flat puffy pentagon: five sides, five corners.

hexagon.description: A flat puffy hexagon: six sides, six corners (like a honeycomb cell).

octagon.description: A flat puffy octagon: eight sides (like a stop sign).

half_circle.description: A flat half circle, flat side down (a half pizza, a rainbow base).

quarter_circle.description: A flat quarter circle: a quarter of a pizza, corner at the origin.

arrow.description: A flat arrow pointing right (+x); turn it to point anywhere (maps, directions).

cross.description: A flat X mark (treasure maps, wrong answers).

drop.description: A flat water drop, pointed at the top.

leaf.description: A thin flat leaf with pointed ends (falling leaves, plants).

ring.description: A flat ring with a round hole in the middle.

cup.description: An open cup or jar, 1 m tall: thin walls and a bottom, so you can see into it (glasses, jugs, tubs, buckets).

pot.description: A flower pot or bucket: wider at the top, with a rim, open.

bowl.description: An open bowl, 1 wide and 0.5 tall.

tube.description: An open pipe with no ends (tunnels, pipes, a telescope).

bottle.description: A bottle with a neck, open at the top.

dome.description: Half a ball, flat side down, 0.5 tall (igloos, dens, hills).

disc.description: A coin-like disc with a raised rim, 0.12 thick.

wedge.description: A ramp (a triangular prism): slopes up from +x to -x, depth 1 (slides, ramps, cheese).
